en.headline: Food Expo opens at Wan Chai convention centre with queues for bargains
en.dek: The five-day event and four companion fairs drew more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 places; Financial Secretary Paul Chan said mega events are expected to bring HK$12 billion in spending.
body: Hong Kong’s annual Food Expo opened on Thursday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, with long queues forming before the 10am start as visitors sought discounted products and freebies. The five-day fair runs alongside the Beauty & Wellness Expo, Home Delights Expo, Food Expo PRO and the Hong Kong International Tea Fair.

Organisers said more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions are taking part, including participation from all 11 ASEAN member states for the first time. Opening hours are 10am to 10pm until Sunday and until 6pm on Monday. Tickets range from HK$10 to HK$40 depending on access level; children under three and seniors aged 65 or above enter free.

At the opening ceremony, Financial Secretary Paul Chan noted that more than 230 mega events are expected to draw about 3.6 million visitors this year, generating some HK$12 billion in spending. He described Hong Kong as a platform for brands seeking regional markets, citing its supply chains, certification strengths and international outlook.
Visitors reported arriving as early as 6.30am for limited HK$1 deals and games offering large quantities of abalone. Vendors said they anticipated higher sales than last year.

zh.headline: 美食博覽灣仔會展開鑼 市民清晨排隊搶購
zh.dek: 連同四個同期展覽共逾1850家展商參與，財爺陳茂波指大型活動料帶來120億元消費。
body: 一年一度的美食博覽周四在灣仔香港會議展覽中心開幕，開場前已有大批市民排隊，爭取折扣貨及贈品。展覽一連五日舉行，同期還有美與健生活博覽、家電‧家居‧博覽、美食商貿博覽及香港國際茶展。
主辦單位表示，逾1850家來自30多個國家及地區的展商參與，首次涵蓋全部11個東盟成員國。開放時間為上午10時至晚上10時（周一提前至下午6時），門票10至40元不等，三歲以下小童及65歲或以上長者免費。
財經事務及庫務局局長陳茂波在開幕禮上表示，全年逾230項大型活動預計吸引約360萬名旅客，帶來約120億元消費。他指香港具備高效供應鏈、認證優勢及國際視野，是品牌拓展區域市場的理想平台。
有市民清晨6時半到場輪候一元優惠及遊戲獎品，部分攤檔預計銷售較去年理想。
